title: Latin Hip-Hop
tagline: Rap shaped by Spanish-language flows, regional rhythms and urban storytelling.
summary: Latin hip-hop brings rap into Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking communities while keeping the core ideas of rhythm, narration and movement. It grows from local scenes in Latin America and the United States but quickly becomes transnational, mixing Caribbean, African and urban influences. The style feels flexible, rhythmic and highly local at the same time.
origin_place: United States, Latin America and the Caribbean

pillars.name: Vico C
pillars.why: Vico C helped establish a respected Spanish-language rap lineage grounded in lyrical craft and personal voice.

pillars.name: Residente
pillars.why: Residente brought a sharp, highly personal perspective to Latin hip-hop and expanded its reach beyond the club.

pillars.name: Calle 13
pillars.why: Calle 13 combined rigorous writing with a broad cultural frame that made the form feel expansive and contemporary.
